# Feature: Fire tile — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #43 (Fire tile) from Terrain and Hazards before it is used in real levels. Effect: Burns on flammable floor, spreads slowly, burns out; an ice block cancels it. Unique: fire that spreads on flammable floor, burns out, and is cancelled by ice. Useful: spend an ice block to cancel it, or wait for it to burn out. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** burns on flammable floor, spreads slowly, burns out; an ice block cancels it.

**So that** spend an ice block to cancel it, or wait for it to burn out.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Fire tile for the first time in its teaching room (mech-43-fire-tile-room). Teaching moment: First room: fire on grass beside the return path, with an ice block in the room. A player who walks past it to collect an orb finds, ten moves later, that it has spread across the path they meant to return by, which teaches that fire is a clock on flammable floor and that the ice block was the way through rather than an ornament. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Fire sits on grass or wood floor and is lethal while burning
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Every 10 moves it spreads to one adjacent flammable tile, and each fire tile burns out after 30 moves leaving safe scorched floor, so it never burns forever
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: An ice block slid or pushed into a fire tile melts and cancels that fire tile, a hazard and a slippy block cancelling each other like a key and keylock

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Every 10 moves it spreads to one adjacent flammable tile, and each fire tile burns out after 30 moves leaving safe scorched floor, so it never burns forever
- An ice block slid or pushed into a fire tile melts and cancels that fire tile, a hazard and a slippy block cancelling each other like a key and keylock
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.
- No soft-lock: every reachable state has a legal move, a lose, or a reset.
- Definition audit: fire: hazard defined here; lethal while burning on flammable floor, spreads on a move count, burns out and is cancelled by one ice block
- Definition audit: flammable floor: grass or wood floor; fire spreads only onto it, never onto stone floor (floor per mechanic 5 in this file)
- Definition audit: ice block: pushable block that cancels fire, per mechanic 82 in blocks.yml

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Fire tile's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Open Questions

- Human review to honour: I think I'd prefer if fire is cancelled out by ice block.
- Human review to honour: its basically a key and keylock, but one is a hazard and the other is slippy block
- Human review to honour: I think fire should be able to started, and spread based on floor tile eg. grass.
- Human review to honour: I think fire shouldn't burn forever
- Synergies deferred to a later run (do not build now): Ice block (82): the intended way through, spend a block to cancel a fire.
- Demos deferred (reference only): Lava tile (44): fire can be cancelled and burns out, lava can do neither.
- Confirm any new sprite/tile def and any HUD counter this mechanic needs before the implement task is approved.
- Dependencies from test cases (blocked-by mechanic ids): 82 . Those cases run when the blocking mechanic lands.

## Testing

Needs a mechanics playground: new — Test Level mech-43-fire-tile-room, built from this mechanic's teaching moment above. What to check there: every rule in Player-Facing Behavior, played in mech-43-fire-tile-room; the teaching moment's first (naive) action should fail as described and the corrected action should succeed. Record play sessions for replay: yes — sessions are the review evidence. Synergy rooms are explicitly deferred to a later run and are not part of this feature's check.
Named test cases (from the candidate file; all must be played):
- Test case spread follows the move clock: fire spreads to one adjacent flammable tile every 10 moves and never onto stone; the count is moves, not seconds
- Test case burn-out boundary: a fire tile burns out after 30 moves leaving scorched floor, and the player can cross it from that move on
- Test case ice cancels fire: blocked-by: 82 (ice block): sliding an ice block into fire melts the block and cancels that one fire tile only
- Test case adversarial waiting game: waiting beside the return path lets fire spread across it as the teaching moment warns; the room still resolves by cancelling or waiting out, never by a stranded state
- Test case restart and replay: restart restores every fire to its placed state, and a recorded 30-move session replays to the same end state
